products.title: 6-Color Seamless Paper Backdrops
products.body_html:
"Create a flawless, seamless background for your products. Our specialized coating on premium paper ensures a smooth transition without distracting lines or reflections."  (Water-Resistant & Anti-Reflective)

  • Specialized Coated Seamless Paper: Unlike standard PVC or plain paper, our backdrops feature a unique coating on high-quality seamless paper, offering exceptional durability and tear resistance while remaining thin and flexible.

  • Anti-Reflective Matte Finish: Engineered with a specialized anti-glare surface to minimize light reflection, ensuring clean, professional shots and significantly reducing post-production editing time.

  • Water & Wrinkle Resistant: Designed to withstand the demands of a busy studio, these backdrops are resistant to light splashes and wrinkles. Simply wipe away spills and keep shooting.

  • Curated Creator’s Color Palette: Includes 6 essential, trend-driven colors handpicked by professional product photographers to suit a wide range of subjects and styles.

  • Seamless Integration with Foldio: Precision-cut to fit perfectly with the Foldio2 Plus, Foldio3, and Foldio4 series, providing a flawless "infinite background" look for every size.

products.title: Heavy Duty Tripod - HD Carbon
products.body_html:
Heavy Duty Carbon Fiber Tripod

The HD Carbon is a lightweight yet sturdy tripod that supports up to 25 kg (55 lb). Weighing just 2.02 kg (4.5 lb), it’s easy to adjust for stable and precise shots every time.

Portable, Easy Storage

When HD Carbon is folded, it measures only 48cm (19 inches) for easy storage in the carry bag.

Anti Slip Design Quick Release Plate

A quick release plate is included, featuring an anti-slip pad that protects your camera from scratches.

Wide Compatibility

Equipped with a 1/4 inch screw, the HD Carbon Tripod is compatible with digital cameras, DSLRs, camcorders, GoPro action cameras, LED ring lights, and more.

±90° Vertical Shooting

The dual U-slot design allows for easy tilting from -90 degrees to +90 degrees.

360 degree Panoramic Shooting

The HD Carbon rotates 360 degrees, allowing you to smoothly adjust angles and capture stunning shots from any perspective.

Leveling Design

Level the stand by matching the bubble in the level indicator.

Quickly Adjust Leg Angles

Effortlessly capture photos from any angle by simply pushing down the angle selector to adjust the tripod legs with precision.

Use HD Carbon with Your Foldio

With this convenient and lightweight tripod, you can save time and energy to focus on the shots that matter.

products.title: Travel Tripod - TT Carbon
products.body_html:
TT Carbon – Lightweight & Durable Carbon Fiber Tripod

Ultra-Light Yet Incredibly Strong
Weighing just 1.29 kg (2.2 lbs) and supporting up to 18 kg (39.6 lbs), the TT Carbon tripod offers unmatched stability for DSLR, mirrorless cameras, and heavy lenses—perfect for travel and professional use.

Compact Folded Size – Just 44 cm (17")
Folds down to a compact size that fits easily in your carry bag or backpack, making it ideal for on-the-go creators and outdoor photographers.

Triangular Central Axis Design
Innovative triangular column delivers a more compact and rigid structure than traditional round columns—optimized for space-saving and portability.

360° Panoramic Ball Head with Quick Leveling
Enjoy smooth 360-degree panoramic shots and ±15° fast leveling for quick, precise angle adjustments. Dual U-slots allow seamless -90° to +90° vertical shooting.

Reverse Center Column for Macro Shots
Flip the center column upside down for low-angle or macro photography with ease.

Pairs Perfectly with Foldio Light Studios
Maximize your efficiency in product photography setups with Foldio compatibility.

📌 Perfect for travel, content creators, product photography, and more.
Sturdy. Portable. Versatile. TT Carbon is the tripod that adapts to your creative needs—anytime, anywhere.
